def _local_writes(fn) -> dict[str, list[ast.AST]]:
    """What becomes part of each local of a function, for the data flow
    (#4085): the value of every assignment to it (plain, unpacked, annotated
    or augmented), the iterable of a `for` loop that binds it, and, for a
    name the function binds that is not a parameter, the arguments of every
    method call on it and every value assigned to an item or attribute of
    it (`parts.append(x)`, `d['k'] = v`, `req.messages[0]['content']
    .extend(...)`): any method may change the object it is called on, as
    for a module constant (#4166). Cached per function node."""
    entry = _WRITES.get(id(fn))
    if entry is not None and entry[0] is fn:
        return entry[1]
    out = _local_values(fn)
    bound = set(out) - set(_params(fn))
    for n in ast.walk(fn):
        if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and _holder(n.func.value) in bound:
            out[_holder(n.func.value)] += ([a.value if isinstance(a, ast.Starred) else a for a in n.args]
                                           + [k.value for k in n.keywords])
        elif isinstance(n, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign, ast.AugAssign)) and n.value is not None:
            for t in n.targets if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) else [n.target]:
                if isinstance(t, (ast.Subscript, ast.Attribute)) and _holder(t) in bound:
                    out[_holder(t)].append(n.value)
    _WRITES[id(fn)] = (fn, out)
    return out

def scan_file(root: Path, surface: Surface, tokens: list[Token]) -> list[dict]:

    Python file that does not parse (#4092), raises: the caller decides, and
    `run` refuses to report on a surface it could not see. Each approach that
    reaches the file judges a hit by the file's role in that approach
    (#4054): text counts where the role is model-facing, where run-shaping
    code renders model text (a function named for it in a run controller, or
    text found by data flow), and on the lines the approach loads whatever
    the role (a description a session lists, #4091); a YAML comment counts
    where the model reads the file raw (#4091); code counts unless the role
    is exposed, and in a YAML, config or shell file that no approach hands
    to a model a branch, default or per-project key is code (#4091); and
    nothing in a `__main__` block counts for an approach that only imports
    the module."""
    path = root / surface.path
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    is_py = path.suffix == ".py"
    tree = None
    if is_py:
        try:
            tree = ast.parse(text)
        except (SyntaxError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise UnparsedSurface(surface.path, exc) from exc
    roles = surface.roles or {a: surface.role for a in surface.approaches}
    # In a run controller, the string literals of a function that renders
    # what a model receives (render_instruction, render_system, ...) are
    # model-facing text even though the module as a whole shapes the run;
    # data flow found the rest at discovery (#4054).
    spans = list(surface.text_spans) if is_py else []
    if is_py and roles.get("run_controllers") == "run_shaping":
        spans += _model_text_ranges(tree)
    main = _main_block_lines(tree) if is_py and any(a not in surface.runs for a in roles) else []
    code_units = not is_py and "model_facing" not in roles.values() and "run_shaping" in roles.values()
    raw_comments = path.suffix.lower() in YAML_SUFFIXES
    hits = []
    for line, context, unit, src in units_for(path, surface.path, text, tree, code=code_units):
        label = next((name for a, b, name in spans if a <= line <= b), None) \
            if context == "string_literal" else None
        in_main = any(a <= line <= b for a, b in main)
        reaches: dict[str, tuple[bool, bool]] = {}
        loaded: dict[str, str] = {}
        raw = False
        for a, r in roles.items():
            here = next((name for lo, hi, name in surface.loaded.get(a, ()) if lo <= line <= hi), None)
            if (r == "exposed" and here is None) or (in_main and a not in surface.runs):
                reaches[a] = (False, False)
                continue
            text_counts = context in MODEL_FACING_CONTEXTS and (r == "model_facing" or label is not None
                                                                or here is not None)
            if context == "comment" and raw_comments and r == "model_facing" and a in surface.raw:
                text_counts = raw = True
            reaches[a] = (text_counts, context in CODE_CONTEXTS and r != "exposed")
            if here is not None and text_counts:
                loaded[a] = here
        model_facing = any(t for t, _ in reaches.values())
        code = any(c for _, c in reaches.values())
        gates_in = sorted(a for a, (t, c) in reaches.items() if (t or c) and APPROACHES[a][0])
        for _, _, tok, matched in match_text(unit, tokens):
            hit = {
                "path": surface.path, "line": line, "approaches": list(surface.approaches),
                "role": surface.role, "status": surface.status, "context": context,
                "category": tok.category, "match": matched, "pattern": tok.pattern,
                "model_facing": model_facing, "code": code, "gates_in": gates_in,
                "snippet": src.strip()[:180],
            }
            if label is not None:
                hit["model_text_function"] = label
            if in_main:
                hit["main_block"] = True
            if loaded:
                hit["loaded_in"] = loaded
            if raw:
                hit["read_raw"] = True
            hits.append(hit)
    return hits

def test_plain_alias_of_model_text_container_traces_subscript_and_update_writes_5657(self):
        """#5657 (B2 and aliased .update variants): writes through a plain alias
        of a model-text container (`view = contracts; view['worker']['hint'] = ...`
        and `view = contracts; view['worker'].update(...)` / `view.update(...)`)
        trace into the helper module just like direct writes on `contracts` (B3)."""
        cases = (
            ("B2_plain_alias_subscript",
             '    view = contracts\n    view["worker"]["hint"] = project_hint(project)\n'),
            ("B3_direct_subscript",
             '    contracts["worker"]["hint"] = project_hint(project)\n'),
            ("plain_alias_nested_update",
             '    view = contracts\n    view["worker"].update({"hint": project_hint(project)})\n'),
            ("plain_alias_top_update",
             '    view = contracts\n    view.update({"worker": {"hint": project_hint(project)}})\n'),
            ("nested_subscript_alias_store",
             '    view = contracts["worker"]\n    view["hint"] = project_hint(project)\n'),
        )
        for label, mutation in cases:
            with self.subTest(case=label), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                runner = PRECISION_RUNNER.replace(
                    "from pathlib import Path\n",
                    "from pathlib import Path\nfrom data_sheets_schema import contracts_5657\n",
                ).replace(
                    "[guide, value, ids_4085.label(spec)]",
                    "[guide, value, ids_4085.label(spec), contracts_5657.render_worker(spec)]",
                )
                modules = dict(PRECISION_MODULES)
                modules["project_hints"] = (
                    "def project_hint(project: str) -> str:\n"
                    '    return f"Review the CHORUS cohort for {project}."\n'
                )
                modules["contracts_5657"] = (
                    "from data_sheets_schema.project_hints import project_hint\n\n"
                    "def _contracts_seed() -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:\n"
                    '    return {"worker": {"stage": "worker"}}\n\n'
                    "def _role_contracts(project: str = \"\") -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:\n"
                    "    contracts = _contracts_seed()\n"
                    + mutation +
                    "    return contracts\n\n"
                    "def render_worker(spec) -> str:\n"
                    '    return str(_role_contracts(spec.project)["worker"])\n'
                )
                root = self._root(directory, runner, modules)
                derived, spans, _ = self._derive(root)
                self.assertIn("project_hints", derived)
                self.assertEqual(
                    self._violations(root, "src/data_sheets_schema/project_hints.py", derived, spans),
                    {("CHORUS", 2)},
                )
                off, off_spans, _ = self._derive(root, sinks=False)
                self.assertNotIn("project_hints", off)
                self.assertEqual(
                    self._violations(root, "src/data_sheets_schema/project_hints.py", off, off_spans),
                    set(),
                )

            ("plain_alias_top_update",

                runner = PRECISION_RUNNER.replace(

def _require_complete_outcome(tree, case, document, baseline):
    for name in ('hits', 'violations', 'test_dependencies'):
        assert type(document[name]) is list and all(type(row) is dict for row in document[name])
    observed = Counter(encoded(row) for row in document['violations'])
    assert not baseline - observed, 'one or more complete D128 baseline violations changed or disappeared'
    assert len(document['violations']) == case['expected_violations']
    extra = observed - baseline
    name = case['name']
    if name == 'F0':
        assert observed == baseline
        return []
    relative, contexts, gates = PLANTED[name]
    snippets = {snippet for _, snippet in contexts}
    planted = [hit for hit in document['hits'] if hit['path'] == relative
               and hit['match'] == 'CHORUS' and hit['snippet'] in snippets]
    assert Counter((hit['context'], hit['snippet']) for hit in planted) == Counter(contexts)
    lines = (tree / relative).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    for hit in planted:
        matching = [index + 1 for index, line in enumerate(lines) if line.strip() == hit['snippet']]
        assert matching == [hit['line']]
        assert hit['category'] == 'gc_project' and hit['gates_in'] == gates
    if name in KNOWN_GAPS:
        assert case['known_gap'] == KNOWN_GAPS[name]
        assert observed == baseline and not extra
        assert all(hit['role'] == 'run_shaping' and hit['model_facing'] is False
                   and hit['violation'] is False and hit['gates_in'] == [] for hit in planted)
    else:
        assert case['known_gap'] is None
        assert all(hit['role'] == 'model_facing' and hit['violation'] is True for hit in planted)
        assert extra == Counter(encoded(hit) for hit in planted)
    return planted

        head = inputs.git('rev-parse', '--verify', 'HEAD^{commit}').decode().strip()
        exports = tmp_path / 'exports'
        exports.mkdir()
        monkeypatch.setattr(inputs, 'SCRATCH', exports)
        label = 'scanner-candidate-' + head[:9]
        inputs.materialize(label, head, inputs.BASE_SCAN_PATHS)
        tree, manifest = inputs.checked_scanner_input(label, head)
        require_scanner_inventory(manifest)
        expected = {name: dict(sha256=row['sha256'], bytes=row['bytes'], mode=int(row['mode'], 8) & 0o777)
                    for name, row in manifest['files'].items()}
        evidence.update(commit=head, commit_tree=manifest['commit_tree'],
                        input_path_mask=manifest['path_mask'], input_entry_count=manifest['entry_count'],
                        input_total_blob_bytes=manifest['total_blob_bytes'], root=str(tree),
                        mutations=_apply_edits(tree, case, expected))
        tool = tree / SKILL / 'scan.py'
        assets = {name: row['sha256'] for name, row in manifest['files'].items()
                  if name.startswith(SKILL + '/')}
        command = [sys.executable, '-P', '-B', str(tool), '--root', str(tree),
                   '--report', str(output / 'scan.md'), '--json', str(output / 'scan.json'),
                   '--tokens', str(tool.with_name('tokens.yaml')),
                   '--exceptions', str(tool.with_name('exceptions.yaml')), '--full-json']
        env = {key: os.environ[key] for key in ('PATH', 'HOME', 'TMPDIR', 'VIRTUAL_ENV') if key in os.environ}
        env.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', PYTHONNOUSERSITE='1', PIP_NO_INDEX='1', UV_OFFLINE='1')
        evidence.update(command=command, tool_assets_sha256=assets, timeout_seconds=600)
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=tree, env=env, capture_output=True, timeout=600)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            (output / 'stdout.txt').write_bytes(error.stdout or b'')
            (output / 'stderr.txt').write_bytes(error.stderr or b'')
            evidence['timed_out'] = True
            raise
        finally:
            evidence['seconds'] = time.monotonic() - started
        (output / 'stdout.txt').write_bytes(completed.stdout)
        (output / 'stderr.txt').write_bytes(completed.stderr)
        evidence['returncode'] = completed.returncode
        _require_unchanged_tree(tree, expected)
        evidence['input_bytes_and_inventory_stable'] = True
        assert inputs.git('rev-parse', '--verify', 'HEAD^{commit}').decode().strip() == head
        assert completed.returncode == case['expected_exit'], completed.stderr.decode(errors='replace')
        if completed.returncode == 2:
            stderr = completed.stderr.decode('utf-8')
            assert 'configuration error (exit 2, the scan did not happen)' in stderr
            assert REFUSALS[case['name']] in stderr
            assert not (output / 'scan.json').exists()
            evidence['status'] = 'retained_configuration_refusal'
        else:
            report = output / 'scan.json'
            assert report.is_file() and report.stat().st_size > 0
            document = json.loads(report.read_bytes())

                            violation_count=len(document['violations']),

                                           for name in ('hits', 'violations', 'test_dependencies')})

            evidence['status'] = ('retained_known_gap' if case['known_gap'] else 'retained_complete_outcome')
    except Exception as error:
        evidence['failure'] = type(error).__name__ + ': ' + str(error)
        raise

        evidence['output_sha256'] = {path.name: _sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in output.iterdir()
                                    if path.is_file() and path.name != 'run.json'}

def scan_file(root: Path, surface: Surface, tokens: list[Token]) -> list[dict]:
    """Every token hit in one surface. A file that cannot be read, or a
    Python file that does not parse (#4092), raises: the caller decides, and
    `run` refuses to report on a surface it could not see. Each approach that
    reaches the file judges a hit by the file's role in that approach
    (#4054): text counts where the role is model-facing, where run-shaping
    code renders model text (a function named for it in a run controller, or
    text found by data flow), and on the lines the approach loads whatever
    the role (a description a session lists, #4091); a YAML comment counts
    where the model reads the file raw (#4091); code counts unless the role
    is exposed, and in a YAML, config or shell file that no approach hands
    to a model a branch, default or per-project key is code (#4091); and
    nothing in a `__main__` block counts for an approach that only imports
    the module."""
    path = root / surface.path
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    is_py = path.suffix == ".py"
    tree = None
    if is_py:
        try:
            tree = ast.parse(text)
        except (SyntaxError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise UnparsedSurface(surface.path, exc) from exc
    roles = surface.roles or {a: surface.role for a in surface.approaches}
    # In a run controller, the string literals of a function that renders
    # what a model receives (render_instruction, render_system, ...) are
    # model-facing text even though the module as a whole shapes the run;
    # data flow found the rest at discovery (#4054).
    spans = list(surface.text_spans) if is_py else []
    if is_py and roles.get("run_controllers") == "run_shaping":
        spans += _model_text_ranges(tree)
    main = _main_block_lines(tree) if is_py and any(a not in surface.runs for a in roles) else []
    code_units = not is_py and "model_facing" not in roles.values() and "run_shaping" in roles.values()
    raw_comments = path.suffix.lower() in YAML_SUFFIXES
    hits = []
    for line, context, unit, src in units_for(path, surface.path, text, tree, code=code_units):
        label = next((name for a, b, name in spans if a <= line <= b), None) \
            if context == "string_literal" else None
        in_main = any(a <= line <= b for a, b in main)
        reaches: dict[str, tuple[bool, bool]] = {}
        loaded: dict[str, str] = {}
        raw = False
        for a, r in roles.items():
            here = next((name for lo, hi, name in surface.loaded.get(a, ()) if lo <= line <= hi), None)
            if (r == "exposed" and here is None) or (in_main and a not in surface.runs):
                reaches[a] = (False, False)
                continue
            text_counts = context in MODEL_FACING_CONTEXTS and (r == "model_facing" or label is not None
                                                                or here is not None)
            if context == "comment" and raw_comments and r == "model_facing" and a in surface.raw:
                text_counts = raw = True
            reaches[a] = (text_counts, context in CODE_CONTEXTS and r != "exposed")
            if here is not None and text_counts:
                loaded[a] = here
        model_facing = any(t for t, _ in reaches.values())
        code = any(c for _, c in reaches.values())
        gates_in = sorted(a for a, (t, c) in reaches.items() if (t or c) and APPROACHES[a][0])
        for _, _, tok, matched in match_text(unit, tokens):
            hit = {
                "path": surface.path, "line": line, "approaches": list(surface.approaches),
                "role": surface.role, "status": surface.status, "context": context,
                "category": tok.category, "match": matched, "pattern": tok.pattern,
                "model_facing": model_facing, "code": code, "gates_in": gates_in,
                "snippet": src.strip()[:180],

            if loaded:
                hit["loaded_in"] = loaded

                hit["read_raw"] = True

    return hits

                    set(),
                )

    is exposed, and in a YAML, config or shell file that no approach hands
    to a model a branch, default or per-project key is code (#4091); and
    nothing in a `__main__` block counts for an approach that only imports
    the module."""

    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if surface.path == 'src/data_sheets_schema/native_schema_event_reuse.py':
        # The complete source contract is required even when a changed
        # return bypasses the parser container edge that text_flow follows.

    roles = surface.roles or {a: surface.role for a in surface.approaches}
    # In a run controller, the string literals of a function that renders
    # what a model receives (render_instruction, render_system, ...) are
    # model-facing text even though the module as a whole shapes the run;
    # data flow found the rest at discovery (#4054).

    if is_py and roles.get("run_controllers") == "run_shaping":
        spans += _model_text_ranges(tree)
    main = _main_block_lines(tree) if is_py and any(a not in surface.runs for a in roles) else []
    code_units = not is_py and "model_facing" not in roles.values() and "run_shaping" in roles.values()
    raw_comments = path.suffix.lower() in YAML_SUFFIXES
    hits = []
    for line, context, unit, src in units_for(path, surface.path, text, tree, code=code_units):

            if context == "string_literal" else None

def _require_complete_outcome(tree, case, document, baseline):
    for name in ('hits', 'violations', 'test_dependencies'):
        assert type(document[name]) is list and all(type(row) is dict for row in document[name])
    observed = Counter(encoded(row) for row in document['violations'])
    assert not baseline - observed, 'one or more complete D128 baseline violations changed or disappeared'
    assert len(document['violations']) == case['expected_violations']
    extra = observed - baseline
    name = case['name']
    if name == 'F0':
        assert observed == baseline
        return []
    relative, contexts, gates = PLANTED[name]
    snippets = {snippet for _, snippet in contexts}
    planted = [hit for hit in document['hits'] if hit['path'] == relative
               and hit['match'] == 'CHORUS' and hit['snippet'] in snippets]
    assert Counter((hit['context'], hit['snippet']) for hit in planted) == Counter(contexts)
    lines = (tree / relative).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    for hit in planted:
        matching = [index + 1 for index, line in enumerate(lines) if line.strip() == hit['snippet']]
        assert matching == [hit['line']]
        assert hit['category'] == 'gc_project' and hit['gates_in'] == gates

        assert case['known_gap'] == KNOWN_GAPS[name]
        assert observed == baseline and not extra
        assert all(hit['role'] == 'run_shaping' and hit['model_facing'] is False
                   and hit['violation'] is False and hit['gates_in'] == [] for hit in planted)

        assert case['known_gap'] is None
        assert all(hit['role'] == 'model_facing' and hit['violation'] is True for hit in planted)
        assert extra == Counter(encoded(hit) for hit in planted)
    return planted

                        input_path_mask=manifest['path_mask'], input_entry_count=manifest['entry_count'],
                        input_total_blob_bytes=manifest['total_blob_bytes'], root=str(tree),
                        mutations=_apply_edits(tree, case, expected))

            (output / 'stderr.txt').write_bytes(error.stderr or b'')

def scan_file(root: Path, surface: Surface, tokens: list[Token]) -> list[dict]:
    """Every token hit in one surface. A file that cannot be read, or a
    Python file that does not parse (#4092), raises: the caller decides, and
    `run` refuses to report on a surface it could not see. Each approach that
    reaches the file judges a hit by the file's role in that approach
    (#4054): text counts where the role is model-facing, where run-shaping
    code renders model text (a function named for it in a run controller, or
    text found by data flow), and on the lines the approach loads whatever
    the role (a description a session lists, #4091); a YAML comment counts
    where the model reads the file raw (#4091); code counts unless the role
    is exposed, and in a YAML, config or shell file that no approach hands
    to a model a branch, default or per-project key is code (#4091); and
    nothing in a `__main__` block counts for an approach that only imports
    the module."""
    path = root / surface.path
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if surface.path == 'src/data_sheets_schema/native_schema_event_reuse.py':
        # The complete source contract is required even when a changed
        # return bypasses the parser container edge that text_flow follows.
        _native_event_parser_contract(text)
    is_py = path.suffix == ".py"
    tree = None
    if is_py:
        try:
            tree = ast.parse(text)
        except (SyntaxError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise UnparsedSurface(surface.path, exc) from exc
    roles = surface.roles or {a: surface.role for a in surface.approaches}
    # In a run controller, the string literals of a function that renders
    # what a model receives (render_instruction, render_system, ...) are
    # model-facing text even though the module as a whole shapes the run;
    # data flow found the rest at discovery (#4054).
    spans = list(surface.text_spans) if is_py else []
    if is_py and roles.get("run_controllers") == "run_shaping":
        spans += _model_text_ranges(tree)
    main = _main_block_lines(tree) if is_py and any(a not in surface.runs for a in roles) else []
    code_units = not is_py and "model_facing" not in roles.values() and "run_shaping" in roles.values()
    raw_comments = path.suffix.lower() in YAML_SUFFIXES
    hits = []
    for line, context, unit, src in units_for(path, surface.path, text, tree, code=code_units):
        label = next((name for a, b, name in spans if a <= line <= b), None) \
            if context == "string_literal" else None
        in_main = any(a <= line <= b for a, b in main)
        reaches: dict[str, tuple[bool, bool]] = {}
        loaded: dict[str, str] = {}
        raw = False
        for a, r in roles.items():
            here = next((name for lo, hi, name in surface.loaded.get(a, ()) if lo <= line <= hi), None)
            if (r == "exposed" and here is None) or (in_main and a not in surface.runs):
                reaches[a] = (False, False)
                continue
            text_counts = context in MODEL_FACING_CONTEXTS and (r == "model_facing" or label is not None
                                                                or here is not None)
            if context == "comment" and raw_comments and r == "model_facing" and a in surface.raw:
                text_counts = raw = True
            reaches[a] = (text_counts, context in CODE_CONTEXTS and r != "exposed")
            if here is not None and text_counts:
                loaded[a] = here
        model_facing = any(t for t, _ in reaches.values())
        code = any(c for _, c in reaches.values())
        gates_in = sorted(a for a, (t, c) in reaches.items() if (t or c) and APPROACHES[a][0])
        for _, _, tok, matched in match_text(unit, tokens):
            hit = {
                "path": surface.path, "line": line, "approaches": list(surface.approaches),
                "role": surface.role, "status": surface.status, "context": context,
                "category": tok.category, "match": matched, "pattern": tok.pattern,
                "model_facing": model_facing, "code": code, "gates_in": gates_in,
                "snippet": src.strip()[:180],
            }
            if label is not None:
                hit["model_text_function"] = label
            if in_main:
                hit["main_block"] = True
            if loaded:
                hit["loaded_in"] = loaded
            if raw:
                hit["read_raw"] = True
            hits.append(hit)
    return hits

def _require_complete_outcome(tree, case, document, baseline):
    for name in ('hits', 'violations', 'test_dependencies'):
        assert type(document[name]) is list and all(type(row) is dict for row in document[name])
    observed = Counter(encoded(row) for row in document['violations'])
    assert not baseline - observed, 'one or more complete D128 baseline violations changed or disappeared'
    assert len(document['violations']) == case['expected_violations']
    extra = observed - baseline
    name = case['name']
    if name == 'F0':
        assert observed == baseline
        return []
    relative, contexts, gates = PLANTED[name]
    snippets = {snippet for _, snippet in contexts}
    planted = [hit for hit in document['hits'] if hit['path'] == relative
               and hit['match'] == 'CHORUS' and hit['snippet'] in snippets]
    assert Counter((hit['context'], hit['snippet']) for hit in planted) == Counter(contexts)
    lines = (tree / relative).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    for hit in planted:
        matching = [index + 1 for index, line in enumerate(lines) if line.strip() == hit['snippet']]
        assert matching == [hit['line']]
        assert hit['category'] == 'gc_project' and hit['gates_in'] == gates
    if name in KNOWN_GAPS:
        assert case['known_gap'] == KNOWN_GAPS[name]
        assert observed == baseline and not extra
        assert all(hit['role'] == 'run_shaping' and hit['model_facing'] is False
                   and hit['violation'] is False and hit['gates_in'] == [] for hit in planted)
    else:
        assert case['known_gap'] is None
        assert all(hit['role'] == 'model_facing' and hit['violation'] is True for hit in planted)
        assert extra == Counter(encoded(hit) for hit in planted)
    return planted
